errors.evidence: The description states that the years on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are arranged chronologically from 2000 to 2012.

errors.text_span: която се измерва в единици, определени като „дял на автомобилния спрямо водния транспорт“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the figure caption text as the units for the y-axis. The y-axis shows numerical values from 0 to 80,000 without any explicit units mentioned on the axis itself. The phrase from the caption describes the overall topic of the chart, not the unit of measurement.

errors.text_span: с изключение на 2012 г., когато стойността за сухопътен транспорт надвишава тази за воден транспорт
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that 2012 is the only exception where land transport exceeds water transport. The chart clearly shows that the value for land transport (green bar) is also higher than for water transport (light blue bar) in the year 2011.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по хоризонталната ос в азбучен ред, като се започва от 2000 и се приключва с 2012.
errors.evidence: This sentence repeats the error that the years on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically. They are sorted chronologically.
